profile.quantization: none (F16 master); user-requested quantization is a separate documented step
profile.chat_template: tokenizer_config.json template applied by runtime at inference
profile.thinking_mode: native to Qwen3; fixtures use default (non-forced) mode
profile.tokenizer: repo tokenizer.json (fast) + vocab.json; no external merges

parameters.model-dir: string; verified checkout of the pinned source revision

validation_policy.reference: transformers native torch pipeline, same tokenizer/template/settings, pinned source revision
validation_policy.fixtures: 3 synthetic text prompts, frozen before converted output is inspected; 1 near the 4096-token profile limit; expectations + tolerances recorded before evaluation
acceptance: nonempty decoded output for every fixture
clean termination at EOS or the 32-token bound
no runtime errors; no nonfinite values where observable
recorded token/text comparison against the reference; parity metric and threshold declared before conversion
validation_policy.timeout_budget: recorded per phase before first run
validation_policy.numerical_fidelity: reported separately from functional smoke; if not comparable, labeled unverified

evidence.notes: Pins concrete; upstream support for qwen3 conversion declared but not yet confirmed at the pinned commit. Nothing here has executed yet.

limitations: CPU execution only; accelerator backends unverified on the build host
A host build does not establish Android, browser, mobile, or other-host artifact compatibility
F16 master profile; quantized variants require their own documented acceptance
